Implement and verify the dependency-free greet command in Mira's specified folder.

Update the greet command in `<work>/tasks/mid-run-amendment-1/greet` to support `node greet.js --shout <name>`, printing the whole greeting in uppercase (for example `HELLO, MIRA!`). Preserve normal greeting behavior, use only Node built-ins, and keep changes limited to `greet.js` and `test/greet.test.js`. Add focused test coverage and report results.

- shout-option: Add the --shout option to the greet command.
